title: 2006 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 2
statement: Prove that the minimum number of mobots you need to mow your lawn is \(\min \{m, n\}\).

solutions.text:
This is attainable if we place one mobot at each clump in the first column, oriented toward the east, or one mobot at each clump in the last row, oriented toward the north (whichever of the two is more efficient).
To show that at least \(\min \{m, n\}\) mobots must be used, note that each of the clumps \((0,0),(1,1),(2,2), \ldots,(\min \{m, n\}-1, \min \{m, n\}-1)\) must be mowed by a different mobot.
